heading: Where the tuples live in each artifact
text:
## Where the tuples live in each artifact [RBND.2]

| Artifact      | Container                                | Dialect | RT-config |
|---------------|------------------------------------------|---------|-----------|
| DSC           | the `DscHeader` atom                     | ✓       | —         |
| Event trace   | the `StreamHeader` atom                  | ✓       | ✓         |
| DAP trace    | first-line `meta` object in `.dsr`       | ✓       | ✓         |
| Realtime contract | `.dsrt` (compile input) / `RealtimeContract` atom (in `.dsc`) | ✓       | yes — IS the contract |
| Profile measurement | `.profile` TOML (informational; never read by runtime) | ✓ | — |

Specifications: [RDSC], [RFCS.4], [NDBG], [RTCT].
